name: OnePingPerDM
description: If unread messages are sent by a user in DMs multiple times, you'll only receive one audio ping. Read the messages to reset the limit
summary: Only one notification sound per DM until you read it

settings.label: Channel to affect
settings.description: Select the type of DM for the plugin to affect

settings.label: Allow @everyone
settings.description: Receive audio pings for @everyone and @here in group DMs

settings.label: Ignore users
settings.description: User IDs (comma + space) whose pings should NEVER be throttled

settings.label: Always play sound
settings.description: Play the message notification sound even when its disabled

gaps: "Always play sound": Qord has no notification sounds yet.
notes: Qord's notification for a DM is a desktop toast and a taskbar flash (it has no sound yet), so this plugin limits those to the first unread message in each DM.
